title: Unit transport on constant generators
statement: For schemes P,U [def-pc-scheme], a morphism h:U→P, a type A in Type (u+1), an etale object W over P and e∈A, the inverse-image adjunction unit sends the sheafification generator e of C_P(A) at W to gamma_h(A) inverse applied to the equal-valued sheafification generator e of C_U(A) at W×_P U. Here C is [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and gamma is [def-weil-pbc-etale-set-constant-pullback-comparison].

proof.text: Apply the unit equation for uniqueness of left adjoints to the composed constant-sheaf/inverse-image adjunction, transported by the canonical terminal-object comparison. At the terminal object, the constant-sheaf unit is the sheafification generator. The right-adjoint comparison is restriction along the inverse terminal-object isomorphism. Thus the forward constant comparison takes the terminal pulled generator to the terminal constant generator.

Restrict this identity along the unique map from the pulled W to the terminal object. Naturality of the constant comparison, inverse-image unit and sheafification unit identifies the restricted sections. The composition of the terminal inverse isomorphism and this unique map is the pullback of the unique map from W to the terminal object, by terminality. Cancel the forward constant comparison to obtain the claimed inverse-comparison equality. For empty A there is no e; empty schemes require no modification.
